summary: Mood-selector low-mood-prompt + consultant-call trigger iteration PASSED. Mobile viewport 390x844 via Playwright. Demo login +919999900000 (mock OTP → dev-code-box → verify) reached Today tab. (1) Tapping mood-tile-heavy from the Today inline selector logged the check-in AND showed the inline low-mood-prompt with exact copy 'Thanks for checking in.' + 'Would talking to someone help?' + 'Book a 15-min call' + 'I'm okay for now'. low-prompt-book navigated to /psychologists; low-prompt-dismiss present. quicklog-saved was NOT shown for low moods (as expected). (2) Tapping mood-tile-calm (non-low) showed the quicklog-saved thanks pill and did NOT show low-mood-prompt. (3) Detailed check-in modal (add-detail-button → mood-tile-heavy → mood-continue-button → skip context → save-checkin-button) landed on the done screen; low-book-call was rendered as the FIRST option (measured Y=273 vs 353/433/513 for low-see-affecting/low-take-step/low-okay) and navigated to /psychologists on tap. (4) Mood pills render as 3-column gradient tiles with the halo centered behind each emoji GIF (visually confirmed in screenshots). (5) Regression: OTP login and 15-min paid booking flow completed end-to-end — psy-card → session-type-15-min Call → slot-2026-07-19T10:00 → confirm-pay-button → 'Your session is confirmed · Dr. Ananya Rao · 15-min Call · ₹400 · Paid (mock)'. No blocking backend errors. Only console warning observed: react-native-web '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"' — cosmetic, non-blocking (comes from MoodSelector.tile shadow* styles, native-only styling; safe to keep).

react_native_issues.issue: react-native-web logs deprecation warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow'. This originates from styles.tile in /app/frontend/src/MoodSelector.tsx (shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius). Native builds still use these; on web preview a warning is emitted. Non-blocking. If desired, gate web-only style with Platform.OS === 'web' using boxShadow, or ignore.

critical_code_review_comments: index.tsx quickLog (line 37-51): correctly triggers setLowPrompt(true) for LOW_MOODS = ['heavy','anxious','frustrated'] and setJustSaved(true) otherwise. Mutual exclusion via setJustSaved(false) inside the low branch prevents both pills rendering together.
index.tsx low-mood-prompt (line 87-100): low-prompt-book calls setLowPrompt(false) BEFORE router.push('/psychologists') — good; prevents stale prompt on return via useFocusEffect(load).

checkin.tsx done step (line 96-103): OptionRow order is [low-book-call, low-see-affecting, low-take-step, low-okay] — verified via bounding-rect Y positions [273,353,433,513]. Book-call is the first option as spec requires. Each row calls close() before router.push so the modal is dismissed on navigation.
MoodSelector.tsx halo (line 46-48): halo View is centered inside the LinearGradient pill and wraps the MoodEmoji — visual halo is behind/around emoji (not above), matching spec.
MoodSelector.tsx grid (line 60-63): cols=3, tile size derived from Math.min(width,460); grid renders 9 moods as 3x3 — verified in screenshots.
